requiredBehaviors.behavior: disambiguate the person before merging sources
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The prerequisites and disambiguation section require identity resolution before any source merge.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: build a professional timeline with claim and source provenance
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Each timeline entry carries claimRefs, sourceRefs, scope, dates and uncertainties.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: separate direct facts, self-reported professional claims and derived capabilities
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The claim model distinguishes employment facts, self-reported professional claims, derived capabilities and unknowns.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: derive capabilities only from referenced claims
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Every derived capability must contain claimRefs and remain traceable to its supporting claims.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: record research date and evidence currency
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The profile schema requires researchedAt and evidenceCurrentThrough and the workflow requires freshness checks for time-dependent claims.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: turn the profile into a role-fit score
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Role fit and candidate scoring are explicitly outside the skill boundary.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: infer personality traits from titles, prestige or media presence
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Capability extraction forbids inference from prestige, title inflation and media presence, and personality profiling is excluded.
